# deps: tools: restore dsq

Bring `dsq` back into the Go toolset ([#316](DOT-315.md)). **Motivation:** "now it uses a prefixed tag" — upstream started tagging as `v0.22.0` ([release](https://github.com/multiprocessio/dsq/releases/tag/v0.22.0)), so the tool can be pinned to a real version, which was the condition for keeping tools in the module ([#383](DOT-382.md)).
